name: Nick Fury

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Vurulunca taktik yükü kazanır, 15'te engellenemez olur. 2 canı var, 2. canda +%300 saldırı kazanır. Mutant şampiyon kullanmak taktik yükü kazanma şansını azalttığı için neredeyse zorunlu. Yetenek azaltıcı şampiyonlar da yük kazanımını önler.
signatureAbility:
Life Model Decoy
When Nick would be knocked out, his Life Model Decoy is destroyed instead and he returns to the fight with a permanent Fury's Fury Buff and Stun Immunity. However, Nick loses his Infinity Formula and begins taking Direct Damage equal to [5 - 2.23]% of his health per second for the rest of the quest while above 30% max health. The destruction of Nick's decoy Removes all Effects and isn't affected by Ability Accuracy reduction.

abilitySections.title: Battle Scars
content: When striking a Bleeding Opponent Nick's Critical Rating is increased by [305.56] and his attacks ignore 100% of Physical Resistance.
While the Opponent is not under the effect of a Regeneration Buff all of Nick's Bleeds are 100% more potent.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: Ending a combo with a Light Attack has a 100% chance to inflict a Bleed, dealing [4,531.95] damage over 1 second.
Landing any Medium Attack has a 100% chance to inflict a Bleed, dealing [251.78] damage over 6 seconds.
Landing a Heavy Attack has a 100% chance to inflict up to 3 stacks of Bleed, each dealing [503.55] damage over 12 seconds.
When hitting into Auto-Block Nick is Stun Immune and has a 100% chance to inflict a Bleed dealing [503.55] damage over 12 seconds.
Knocking down the Opponent Purifies Nick's non-damaging Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Internal Bleed - Passive
content: If the Opponent gets 8 stacks of Bleed, their Bleed effects are removed and replaced with a Passive Internal Bleed effect which deals [27,191.7] damage over 30 seconds.
While Internal Bleed is active all the Opponent's Bleed Debuffs have an increased duration of 0.2 seconds per Tactical Charge.

abilitySections.title: Tactical Advantage Charges - Passive
content: Nick starts the fight with 6 Charges when fighting an Avenger.
When Nick is Struck he has a 100% chance to gain 1 Tactical Charge. Reduced to 25% against Mutant Opponents.
While Nick is under the effect of a Fury Effect, Tactical Charge durations are paused.
Nick loses 1 Charge every 6 seconds, decreasing to every 4 seconds while at or above 10 total Charges. Additionally if the Opponent performs a Well-Timed Block Nick loses 1 Charge.
At 5+ Charges: Nick's attacks can't Miss or be Evaded.
At 10+ Charges: Nick's Purify effects now target all Debuffs.
At 15+ Charges: Nick becomes Unblockable.
At 20+ Charges: All Charges are removed and replaced with a Fury's Fury Buff which grants [18,127.8] Attack Rating for 10 seconds. All Tactical Charge gains are doubled while Fury's Fury is active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: When performing this attack Nick immediately gains 4 Tactical charges.
Disorients the Opponent, reducing their Block Proficiency by 50% and Defensive Ability Accuracy by 70% for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Nick slashes his Opponent causing up to 4 stacks of Bleed, each dealing [2,517.75] damage over 8 seconds.
50% chance to stun the Opponent for 3 seconds. Stun chance increases by a flat 10% for each of Nick's Tactical charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Additional [20,142] Attack if Fury's Fury is active.
Additional [20,142] Attack if Internal Bleed is active.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Life Model Decoy
content: When Nick would be knocked out, his Life Model Decoy is destroyed instead and he returns to the fight with a permanent Fury's Fury Buff and Stun Immunity. However, Nick loses his Infinity Formula and begins taking Direct Damage equal to [5 - 2.23]% of his health per second for the rest of the quest while above 30% max health. The destruction of Nick's decoy Removes all Effects and isn't affected by Ability Accuracy reduction.
